rule_definitions.velocity_rule: rank ascending recent30_impressions/(prior30_impressions+1); <14 prior GSC days uses neutral ratio 1

rule_definitions.coverage_adjusted_velocity_rule: rank ascending recent30 impressions per observed day divided by prior30 impressions per observed day; insufficient prior coverage uses neutral ratio 1
rule_definitions.coverage_adjusted_acceleration_rule: rank ascending recent7 impressions per observed day divided by recent30 impressions per observed day; <3 recent7 GSC days uses neutral ratio 1

previous_artifact_comparison.note: The previous 95,810 March rows were after an inner future-label join. Zero-lag counts compare the same nominal feature cutoff; the primary scenario additionally withholds the latest seven feature days.

prior_run_context.interpretation: These were one April-feature/May-outcome period on the prior future-filtered population. The combined score did not isolate momentum, and the 100% result requires the new coverage/concentration diagnostics; its cause is unproven.

caveats: Development origins were previously inspected and are not untouched tests.
The 7-day primary reporting delay is an explicit scenario, not a verified warehouse SLA.
Zero-day reporting lag is reported as sensitivity only.
The five development periods include overlapping outcomes and repeated pages/clients; origin SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
June was not read; provenance for all earlier human or external feature-selection decisions is not independently certified, so no untouched final holdout is claimed.
Decline prediction does not establish that refreshing a page improves its outcome.
